references.cppPath: solutions/653. Two Sum IV - Input is a BST/653.cpp
references.insight: Inorder traversal of a BST gives sorted values. Use one iterator ascending and another descending, then apply a two-pointer sum search without storing every node. Each iterator keeps only its current root-to-node traversal stack.
steps: Initialize ascending and descending iterators.
Compare their sum with the target.
Advance the low side for a small sum or the high side for a large sum, stopping when they meet.
references.space: O(h) for the two traversal stacks.
pitfalls: Do not reuse the same node for both summands.
The adapted iterators return node identities, so equal-valued distinct nodes can form a pair.
A single-node tree cannot form a pair.
